$comment: Curated integrations registry (architecture.md § Integrations) — GitHub proves the pattern, one entry, every field earned by what it demonstrably needs. deviceCodeUrl/tokenUrl are GitHub's own stable, public OAuth Device Flow endpoints (github.com/login/device/code, github.com/login/oauth/access_token) — the same for every GitHub OAuth App, so they're safe to ship as data. clientId and url are deliberately empty: both are bound to the specific GitHub OAuth App this project registers (plan.md P9 owner touchpoint — 'create the GitHub OAuth app under the org'), which also decides which MCP endpoint that app is authorized against. Connecting is a no-op until both are filled in; nothing in this file is guessed.
